quarterly_data.signal: 10-K, full year 2025: total revenues $62.6 billion, down 2% (operationally down 2%), and up 6% operationally excluding Comirnaty and Paxlovid; Biopharma segment revenues $61,199 million; Pfizer CentreOne (contract manufacturing and API sales) $1,338 million, up 15% operationally; U.S. revenues $37,078 million; 12 products each above $1 billion made up 65% of total revenues; revenues from collaborative arrangements $10,546 million; purchases of property, plant and equipment $2,629 million; the IRA Medicare Part D redesign cut 2025 revenues by approximately $1 billion, with no material incremental impact expected in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: total revenues $62.6 billion, down 2%; up 6% operationally excluding Comirnaty and Paxlovid

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K, 2025 product revenues: Eliquis $7,961 million (up 7% operationally), Prevnar family $6,494 million (up 1%), Vyndaqel family $6,380 million (up 16%), Comirnaty $4,367 million (down 20%), Ibrance $4,122 million (down 6%), Paxlovid $2,362 million (down 59%), Xtandi $2,194 million (up 8%), Padcev $1,940 million (up 22%), Nurtec ODT/Vydura $1,424 million (up 13%), oncology biosimilars $1,301 million, Abrysvo $1,033 million (up 36%), Lorbrena $1,023 million (up 40%), Adcetris $907 million (down 17%).
quarterly_data.figure: Eliquis $7,961 million; Vyndaqel family $6,380 million; Padcev $1,940 million

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: Pfizer's three largest U.S. wholesaler customers, concentrated in Biopharma, were McKesson 25%, Cencora 16% and Cardinal Health 13% of 2025 total revenues (23%, 17% and 14% in 2024) and 40% of accounts receivable together; contracted remaining performance obligations for firm long-term supply orders were approximately $2.1 billion for Comirnaty and $1.0 billion for Paxlovid at December 31, 2025, delivered primarily from 2026 through 2028; Pfizer expects Comirnaty revenue in 2026 to be concentrated in the second half, like 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: McKesson 25%, Cencora 16%, Cardinal Health 13% of 2025 total revenues

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K, government pricing and exclusivity: the Medicare Maximum Fair Price for Eliquis took effect January 1, 2026; Ibrance and Xtandi were selected for Maximum Fair Prices effective January 1, 2027, and Xeljanz for prices effective January 1, 2028; Pfizer anticipates a significant reduction of revenue from patent-based or regulatory exclusivity expiries in 2026 through 2030; from January 1, 2026 a new Global Hospital and Biosimilars organization in Biopharma took over certain off-patent sterile injectables and biosimilars.

10-K legal proceedings: Moderna sued Pfizer and BioNTech in August 2022 alleging Comirnaty infringes three U.S. patents, and in March 2025 the U.S. Patent Office held two of the Moderna patents invalid; in January 2026 Bayer Cropscience, Monsanto Company and Monsanto Technology sued Pfizer and BioNTech in Delaware alleging Comirnaty infringes a U.S. patent issued in 2010; in December 2025 Bristol Myers Squibb and Pfizer sued Azurity Pharmaceuticals in Delaware alleging its proposed generic apixaban would infringe a formulation patent expiring in 2031.

10-K: in December 2025 Pfizer entered an exclusive global collaboration and in-license agreement with YaoPharma for YP05002, an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist in Phase 1 for chronic weight management; YaoPharma received an upfront payment of $150 million and is eligible for development, regulatory and commercial milestones up to $1.935 billion plus tiered royalties.
quarterly_data.figure: $150 million upfront; milestones up to $1.935 billion

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: in July 2025 Pfizer completed an exclusive global ex-China in-license from 3SBio for SSGJ-707/PF-08634404, a PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody; 3SBio received an upfront payment of $1.25 billion and is eligible for milestones up to $4.8 billion plus tiered double-digit royalties; Pfizer paid $100 million upfront for an option on China rights (exercise fee up to $50 million) and made a $100 million equity investment in 3SBio.
quarterly_data.figure: $1.25 billion upfront; milestones up to $4.8 billion
